title: Show HN: FnScribe – Open-source, offline dictation for macOS
text:
I built FnScribe because I'm pretty privacy concious and wanted a wispr flow-like app that kept everything local and on device. Currently works for Mac (sillicon and intel).

It's dead simple. Hold the fn key, speak and release. I use a quantized Wisper small.en model for transcription. It inserts the text into the active application. There's also a hands-free model for longer dictation. Audio transcription is kept in memory. There's no account or transcription history. Clipboard contents are restored after it inserts it. GPLv3, Mac-only, English only..still in alpha. Hope you enjoy it! Would love some feedback.
summary: 开源离线macOS听写工具FnScribe，支持本地隐私保护，通过fn键快捷录音转文字并插入当前应用，采用量化Whisper模型，无账户和历史记录。

title: Show HN: An HN client that summarises long threads and lets you chat with them
text:
I often find interesting things in Hacker News posts and comments, but threads are often long and take a lot of time to go through.

I built Rundown for this. It's a cross-platform desktop app with Claude Code and Codex integration that gives me a rundown of the post and comments, with links back to the comments it pulled each bit from. I can also chat with the post or the entire thread.
summary: 这是一个Hacker News客户端工具，能自动总结长讨论帖内容并支持用户与帖子对话，整合了Claude Code和Codex技术提供跨平台桌面体验。
